conflicts.where: Lessons 2, 3 and 4 (Lesson 4 overview vs Lesson 3 and Lesson 2)
conflicts.problem: Lesson 2 says students prepared onion and cheek cell slides, and it says nothing of sukuma wiki slides. Lesson 4 says students revisited 'Lesson 3 microscope observation drawings of sukuma wiki leaf cells', but Lesson 3 was an animal-organelle lesson with electron micrographs and no sukuma wiki microscopy. Lesson 2 also says the green colour question 'will be explained in Lesson 4 when students study chloroplasts and where in a plant they are found', but Lesson 4 never addresses where chloroplasts are found or why the onion lacks them. The lessons contradict each other.

conflicts.where: Lesson 3 (10 organelles) vs its own list; Lesson 8 and Lesson 5
conflicts.problem: Lesson 3 says learners studied '10 animal cell organelles', but it lists only 8 (nucleus, mitochondria, ribosomes, rough ER, smooth ER, Golgi, lysosomes, centrioles), so the count is inconsistent. Lesson 3 and Lesson 4 also say the nucleus is present in 'most' cells, while Lesson 8 and Lesson 7 give membrane, cytoplasm and genetic material as the minimum, not ribosomes. Lesson 5 says four universal features including ribosomes. The lessons disagree on the number and list of universal features.
